description: Held-out test descriptions for free-text exposure ingestion. Written by the team as SYNTHETIC test cases; never shown to the model as examples. Expected values are what a careful human would extract. tiv_kes_each null = the text gives no value (the app fills it by stated assumption). housing_class null = the text does not say (the app must flag it, not guess).
